datasets.name: Viewfinder Panoramas digital elevation model
datasets.verbatim: This variable was calculated by first deriving the slope for each 90 m grid cell in the Viewfinder Panoramas digital elevation model (de Ferranti, 2014)... http://www.viewfinderpanoramas.org/dem3.html

datasets.name: GEM Global Active Faults
datasets.verbatim: This variable was derived from a global database of active faults that is not complete but covers most of the world’s land surface (GEM Hazard Team, 2019)... https://github.com/GEMScienceTools/gem-global-active-faults/tree/master/geopackage

datasets.name: Global Lithological Map (GLiM)
datasets.verbatim: The release of open data sets such as the global lithologic map used in this work (Hartmann and Moosdorf, 2012) should enhance landslide research at the global scale.

datasets.name: Soil Moisture Active-Passive Level 4 (SMAP L4)
datasets.verbatim: The Soil Moisture Active Passive Level 4 (SMAP L4) product (Reichle et al., 2018) combines a hydrologic model with satellite observations to produce a high-quality product with continuous coverage.

datasets.name: Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG)
datasets.verbatim: In this model, we use the IMERG Early Product, which is available at a 0.1 degree, 30 min spatiotemporal resolution at https://gpm.nasa.gov/data/imerg.

datasets.name: Global Landslide Catalog (GLC)
datasets.verbatim: Both catalogs can be viewed and downloaded at https://landslides.nasa.gov/viewer.

datasets.name: United States Landslide Inventory
datasets.verbatim: As part of the National Climate Assessment, landslide inventories from across the United States of America were compiled into a single database of rainfall-triggered landslides with known dates (Kelkar et al., 2017).

datasets.name: National Landslide Inventory of Australia
datasets.verbatim: The Australian government has published a long-term national record of landslides (Geoscience Australia, 2018)... http://pid.geoscience.gov.au/dataset/ga/74273

datasets.name: 2016 Active Events Map
datasets.source: Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos - Escenarios (2016)
datasets.verbatim: Ecuador has published many landslides that occurred during the year 2016 (Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos - Escenarios, 2016)... https://sgr-ecuador.carto.com/datasets

datasets.name: Map of slope-failure locations in Puerto Rico after Hurricane María
datasets.verbatim: Puerto Rico (Hughes et al., 2019) enriched the coverage of the Americas.

methods.name: LHASA version 2
methods.summary: A data-driven landslide nowcasting model using the XGBoost machine learning framework. It integrates static variables (topography, lithology, faults) and dynamic variables (rainfall, soil moisture, snow mass) to predict the probability of landslide occurrence.
methods.verbatim: To enable other institutions to run the model, the source code will be published at https://github.com/nasa/LHASA.

availability.author_statement: The raw data supporting the conclusions of this article will be made available by the authors, without undue reservation.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventories and input datasets are referenced and accessible via public repositories or established data portals. The custom model code is provided via a persistent GitHub repository link.
